arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the accepted cartoon mermaid sprite and the edit target. Make an EXPRESSION-ONLY correction limited to her single visible eye, eyelid, and eyebrow. Replace the wide-open worried or sad eye with a clearly exasperated 'no more' look: lower the upper eyelid so the visible eye is half-lidded and narrowed, with an annoyed tired gaze. Change the high worried eyebrow into a lowered or slightly pinched tired brow that reads irritated and fed up, not frightened, sad, pleading, or surprised. Keep her mouth closed and unsmiling exactly as it is. Preserve every other detail unchanged: the away-facing profile angle, head and hair, cyan headband, identity, both arms, both outward-facing open palms, all fingers, pushing pose, green swimsuit, visible abdomen and navel, green tail start, lower blue waterline, framing, colors, bold ink, cel shading, and true RGBA transparency. Do not move, redraw, add, or remove anything outside the visible eye and brow area. No text or background.
